scope: Only masked old shoreline marks are imported. The generated whole-painting restoration sources are never used as map replacements.

prompts.clean-1: Precise local restoration of this EXACT existing square game painting for animation compositing. Preserve pixel registration, every building, ground/path/cliff/rock silhouette, all props, painting palette, original camera, composition and texture. ONLY remove the thin pale cream/cyan painted foam/contact/ripple lines from the water at the feet of cliffs and coastal rocks, restoring the immediately adjoining existing water paint beneath those tiny lines. Do not move any coast edge. Do NOT remove waterfalls, clouds, pale rock highlights, foliage, paving marks, windows, glass or architecture. No animation, no new foam, no new content. Output the same square map with ONLY the old tiny waterline marks cleaned out. This will be clipped to a precise shoreline-only alpha mask; all other generated pixels will be discarded. Match local water colors closely; no uniform fill, no dark outlines, no colorgrading.
